artifact_ref_policy.description: Each case declares expected gate-result, trace, and audit artifacts that a future runner must write.

cases.title: Deny request without a virtual key or principal binding
cases.intent: Missing auth stops before provider selection.

assertions: Missing auth stops before provider selection.
The client error uses the typed gateway denial shape.
Audit records provider_attempt_count=0.

cases.intent: The gateway returns an OpenAI-compatible model list shape in fixture mode.

assertions: The gateway returns an OpenAI-compatible model list shape in fixture mode.
Model ids are aliases, not live provider model names or credentials.
Audit records the registry snapshot and virtual key principal.

cases.intent: The gateway accepts OpenAI chat completions shape and routes by model alias.

assertions: The gateway accepts OpenAI chat completions shape and routes by model alias.
The response includes id, object, choices, finish_reason, and usage.
Synthetic usage is attributed without marking the request billable.

cases.intent: OpenAI streaming emits data-prefixed JSON chunks and a terminal [DONE].

assertions: OpenAI streaming emits data-prefixed JSON chunks and a terminal [DONE].
Chunk payloads include synthetic deltas and no provider-native secret fields.
Trace records stream_event_count, terminal_finish_reason, and terminal usage.

cases.title: Return stable typed gateway error shape for synthetic provider failure
cases.intent: Error response includes code, message, trace_id, retryable, and details.policy_reason.

assertions: Error response includes code, message, trace_id, retryable, and details.policy_reason.
Provider raw error body is redacted from client output and retained only as synthetic fixture metadata.
